fault.dead-battery.name: Worn-out battery
fault.dead-battery.symptom: Won't start, just a clicking sound when I turn the key.
fault.dead-battery.book: Clicking + low voltage = worn battery. Replace it: (−) off first, (+) on first.
fault.alternator.name: Broken alternator
fault.alternator.symptom: A battery light came on and there's a squeal from the engine.
fault.alternator.mislead: My battery keeps dying. I'm sure it just needs a new battery!
fault.alternator.book: Low voltage only while running + battery light = the alternator is not charging.
fault.starter.name: Faulty starter motor
fault.starter.symptom: It clicks but the engine won't turn over.
fault.starter.mislead: Dead battery again, I bet. It just clicks!
fault.starter.book: Clicking but the battery tests fine = the starter motor has failed.
fault.spark-plugs.name: Worn spark plugs
fault.spark-plugs.symptom: It shakes at idle and jerks when I speed up.
fault.spark-plugs.book: Misfire code + rough idle = worn spark plugs.
fault.fuel-pump.name: Failed fuel pump
fault.fuel-pump.symptom: The engine turns over but never starts.
fault.fuel-pump.mislead: It won't start. Must be the starter, right?
fault.fuel-pump.book: Cranks but no start + low fuel pressure = the fuel pump.
fault.air-filter.name: Clogged air filter
fault.air-filter.symptom: It feels slow and weak, even on small hills.
fault.air-filter.book: Weak, runs rich + air flow code = clogged air filter.
fault.brake-pads.name: Worn brake pads
fault.brake-pads.book: Squeal + long stops + thin pads under the car = new brake pads.
fault.brake-disc.name: Warped brake disc
fault.brake-disc.symptom: The pedal shakes when I brake.
fault.brake-disc.book: Shaking pedal + scored disc = replace the brake disc.
fault.flat-tyre.name: Punctured tyre
fault.flat-tyre.book: Pulls + low pressure on one tyre (a nail!) = new tyre.
fault.tie-rod.name: Worn tie rod
fault.tie-rod.symptom: It pulls to one side and clunks.
fault.tie-rod.mislead: It pulls to the left. Probably a flat tyre!
fault.tie-rod.book: Pulls but the tyres are fine + play in the tie rod = new tie rod.
fault.exhaust-leak.name: Exhaust leak
fault.exhaust-leak.symptom: It's suddenly as loud as a tractor!
fault.exhaust-leak.book: Loud roar + rusty hole under the car = new muffler.
fault.oil-leak.name: Leaking oil pan gasket
fault.oil-leak.symptom: There's a dark puddle where I park.
fault.oil-leak.mislead: The oil light is on. Just top it up, please!
fault.oil-leak.book: Oil light + drips under the car = new gasket, then top up the oil.
fault.coolant-leak.name: Leaking radiator hose
fault.coolant-leak.symptom: The temperature needle goes into the red.
fault.coolant-leak.book: Overheating + green drips = new radiator hose, then top up the coolant.
fault.thermostat.name: Stuck thermostat
fault.thermostat.symptom: The heater only blows cold air.
fault.thermostat.mislead: My heater is broken. Can you fix the fan?
fault.thermostat.book: Engine never warms up + code P0128 = the thermostat is stuck open.
fault.catalyst.name: Clogged catalytic converter
fault.catalyst.mislead: Something smells awful. I think a mouse got into the exhaust!
fault.catalyst.book: Rotten egg smell + code P0420 = new catalytic converter.
fault.shock.name: Worn shock absorber
fault.shock.symptom: It bounces like a boat on bumpy roads.
fault.shock.book: Bouncy ride + leaking shock = new shock absorber.
fault.low-oil.name: Low engine oil
fault.low-oil.book: Oil light but nothing drips = the oil is just low: top it up.
fault.ev-charger.name: Faulty charging module
fault.ev-charger.book: Will not charge + code P0D27 = new charging module.
fault.scratch.name: Scratched paint
fault.scratch.symptom: And could you fix this ugly scratch on the door?
fault.scratch.book: Sand it, spray it, polish it.
